# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne wears sleeves that are notably puffier than those of anyone else in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an innovative and dedicated educator who believes in holistic student development rather than routine drill. She incorporates nature study, field trips, recitations, and physical culture into her curriculum. She shows deep care for her students, offering them practical advice and moving them to tears upon her departure.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009)_

## History

Miss Thorne served as a rural schoolteacher at Brierley School. During her tenure, she introduced Friday afternoon recitations, field trips to examine local flora and fauna, and daily physical culture routines. At the end of June, her term and reign at Brierley came to a close, leaving her students—including Nell and Isolde—deeply moved and tearful during her parting remarks. Prior to the Academy entrance examinations, she advised her pupils against last-minute studying, recommending instead that they take walks and rest early. She also personally accompanied several students, including Nell, Odette, Opal, and Flossie, to the Academy in town on their exam day.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P42](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0042), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P9](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0009), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_
